title: Unlocking Nellore's Shrimp Processing Potential
subtitle: From aquaculture capital to value-addition hub — why the district must move up the shrimp chain
audience: Capacity building programme | Government of Andhra Pradesh

sections.title: The Problem We Are Trying to Solve

items.title: The raw-commodity trap
items.body: Most Nellore shrimp leaves the district as head-on, shell-on raw — the lowest-margin form in the global chain.

items.title: Value leaks downstream
items.body: Peeling, IQF, breading, cooking and branding — the profitable steps — happen in Vizag, Chennai, or overseas.

items.title: Farm-gate price volatility
items.body: Ponds are exposed to global spot swings, anti-dumping duties, and a handful of buyers. Farmer income is fragile.

items.title: Concentrated risk
items.body: Near-total dependence on Vannamei and a few export markets. One disease outbreak or tariff decision hits the whole district.

sections.title: The Answer: Build the Processing Ecosystem

blocks.text: Shift Nellore from a shrimp-production district to a shrimp-value district. Anchor processing, cold chain, testing and branding inside the district — so the margins that currently leave with the truck stay with local farmers, workers and MSMEs.

sections.title: How the Model Works: One Integrated Chain

stages.name: Farm
stages.desc: Hatchery-linked ponds; SPF seed, BMP protocols

stages.name: Aggregate
stages.desc: FPO / cluster procurement, ice at pond-side

stages.name: Cold chain
stages.desc: Reefer trucks, cold storage, port linkage

blocks.closing: Nellore captures every link — not just the pond

blocks.text: Today, most links after "Aggregate" happen outside the district. Localising even two of them — processing and cold chain — meaningfully lifts realised price per kg and creates thousands of downstream jobs.

items.title: Quality seed & hatcheries
items.body: SPF broodstock, cluster-linked hatcheries, and BMPs to bring down disease losses at pond level.

items.title: Modern processing units
items.body: IQF lines, peeling, breading, ready-to-cook — closer to the ponds, not 500 km away.

items.title: Cold chain & port linkage
items.body: Ice plants, reefer trucks, cold storage, and short haul to Krishnapatnam/Chennai for export.

items.title: Testing & certification
items.body: NABL labs, antibiotic-residue testing, BAP/ASC certification — the passport to premium markets.

items.title: Traceability & branding
items.body: Blockchain-linked pond-to-pack traceability; a "Nellore Shrimp" origin brand for global buyers.

sections.title: Who Benefits — Farmers, Workers and the State

cols.title: For Farmers & Workers
items: Direct access to processors + export markets, less middleman leakage
Fairer, more stable farm-gate prices tied to processed-product value
Thousands of downstream jobs — especially for women in peeling & packing
Skill upgrade via training in HACCP, food safety, and cold-chain handling
Insurance, credit and quality-input access through FPO / cluster structures

cols.title: For the District & Global Buyers
items: MSME cluster growth — packaging, ice, transport, testing, engineering
Higher GST / export revenue captured within the district and the state
Environmental compliance built in — ETPs, waste-water reuse, mangrove buffers
Traceable, certified product for US / EU / Japan retail chains
A resilient, diversified shrimp economy, less exposed to a single buyer or tariff

items.title: Map & mobilise
items.body: Identify shrimp-farming clusters and existing FPOs by mandal. Prioritise mandals with high pond density, weak processing, and viable land near a highway/port corridor.

items.title: Anchor the processing zone
items.body: Designate a shrimp processing cluster (SEZ / mega food park model). Blend private capex with MPEDA, PMMSY, NABARD and state matching support.

items.title: Build shared infrastructure
items.body: Common ice plants, effluent treatment, testing labs, cold storage, reefer parking. Shared infra brings small processors above the compliance bar.

items.title: Certify for premium markets
items.body: Push BAP, ASC, MSC and country-of-origin certification. Pre-empt US anti-dumping duties with clean, traceable, documented supply.

items.title: Link to markets & diversify
items.body: Anchor buyer contracts (US/EU/Japan retail), plus a domestic Nellore-brand play. Diversify products: ready-to-cook, sushi-grade, chitosan from shell waste.

items.title: Disease & broodstock quality
items.body: EHP, WSSV and running-mortality risk. Cluster-linked SPF hatcheries, biosecurity, and pond-side diagnostics are non-negotiable.

items.title: Antibiotic residue & rejections
items.body: Even a single shipment failure hurts India's brand. Push farmer-level compliance and pre-shipment residue testing.

items.title: Effluent & environmental load
items.body: High-density ponds strain groundwater and coastal ecology. Mandatory ETPs, water reuse, and mangrove-buffer zones.

items.title: Tariff & anti-dumping exposure
items.body: US CVD/AD duties can swing quickly. Certified, traceable supply + diversified geographies is the hedge.

items.title: Capital intensity of cold chain
items.body: IQF and reefer infra are lumpy investments. Phase spend, blend PMMSY/NABARD subsidies, use anchor-buyer commitments.

items.title: Processing is the multiplier
items.body: The same kilo of Nellore shrimp is worth 2–4× more once peeled, IQF-frozen and value-added. That gap is captured today by someone else.

items.title: Cluster, don't scatter
items.body: Processing thrives on density — shared ice, ETPs, labs, port access. Concentrate incentives in a few well-chosen zones, not every mandal.

items.title: Compliance is the moat
items.body: BAP, ASC, MSC and clean residue records are what unlock US, EU and Japan retail. Certification is not paperwork — it is the product.

items.title: Diversify what you sell
items.body: Move beyond frozen HOSO. Ready-to-cook, sushi-grade, breaded, chitosan and marine-collagen open new margins and hedge tariff risk.

items.title: Farmers gain only if integrated
items.body: Processing without the farmer in the value chain reproduces the middleman problem. Anchor FPOs and cluster contracts from day one.

sections.title: From Case for Action to Action
sections.lead: Your task before you leave today:

items.body: Name one high-density shrimp-farming cluster in your mandal fit for a processing pilot.
Identify one existing FPO / MSME processor to strengthen — or partners to bring together.
List the partners (MPEDA, NABARD, banks, exporters) you can bring to the table.

blocks.text: Nellore already grows the shrimp — the next decade decides whether it also earns from it.
